note: ransomware.live: victims posted on ransomware groups' leak sites, as observed by the tracker.
title: Ransomware leak-site victim posts (ransomware.live)
description: One event per victim a ransomware group posts on its leak site, as first observed by ransomware.live. The group is an entity; group names are normalised (lower case, every LockBit variant is 'lockbit') and the name as listed is kept as an attribute. The group's own claim text is the record's text: a claim, not a verified fact.
